/bin/bash -lc "cat << 'EOF' > /workspace/openai_client.py
\"\"\"OpenAI Responses API client using only Python standard library.\"\"\"
import urllib.request
import json
import ssl


def send_prompt(api_key, prompt, model=\"gpt-4o\", endpoint=\"https://api.openai.com/v1/responses\"):
    \"\"\"Send a private text prompt to OpenAI's Responses API.\"\"\"
    data = json.dumps({
        \"model\": model,
        \"input\": prompt,
    }).encode(\"utf-8\")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        endpoint,
        data=data,
        headers={
            \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {api_key}\",
            \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",
        },
        method=\"POST\",
    )
    context = ssl.create_default_context()
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=context) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode(\"utf-8\"))
EOF"
